Join us where excitement meets innovation and contribute to a world where trust and technology unite.\n\n\n\nWhat We Offer\n\n - Comprehensive Benefits: We provide a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans with company match, paid time off, parental leave, and an annual education & training stipend (equivalent to $1,000 in local currency). Specific benefits may vary by location and will be discussed further during the interview process.\n\n - Flexible Hybrid Working Environment: Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Many locations also feature parent rooms, on-site gyms, comfortable lounges, and adaptable workstations to support your comfort and productivity.\n\n - Wellness: We care about your well-being. Team members have access to wellness workshops and events, as well as a complimentary Headspace subscription to help you stay focused, grounded, and energized.\n\n - Employee Resource Groups: Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.\n   \n   \n\n\nPOSITION SUMMARY:\n\nTrulioo is seeking a commercially minded and execution-oriented Senior Director, Global Privacy & Data Protection to lead our global privacy strategy, data protection program, and designated Data Protection Officer.\n\n\n\nReporting to the Chief Risk and Strategy Officer, this role will actively lead how privacy, data protection, AI governance, and responsible data use are embedded across Trulioo’s products, operations, commercial motions, and governed by leading practices. This is a senior leadership role for a privacy executive who can operate in scaling, agile environments and partnering with Product, Engineering, Legal, Security, Enterprise Risk, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.\n\n\n\nThe ideal candidate brings extensive expertise in GDPR, U.S. state privacy laws, and Canadian privacy laws, with experience in emerging areas including, but not limited to, biometrics, AI, age verification, data retention, data classification, and emerging identity technologies.\n\n\n\nThis role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.\n\n\n\nThis will be a full-time, permanent position working on a hybrid model from one of our North American offices or fully remote.\n\n\n\n\nWHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:\n\nGlobal Privacy Strategy & DPO\n\n - Build and lead Trulioo’s global privacy and data protection strategy across priority markets, products, customers, and operating environments.\n\n - Serve as Trulioo’s designated Data Protection Officer for Europe, providing independent, credible, and commercially practical advice on GDPR and related obligations.\n\n - Advise executive leadership, as needed, on privacy risk, regulatory change, customer expectations, and strategic trade-offs tied to product innovation and market expansion.\n\n - Represent Trulioo in privacy-related engagements with regulators, enterprise customers, industry groups, and other external stakeholders.\n\n - Act as a strategic advisor on privacy and data protection implications as Trulioo expands into new operating regions, verticals, and expands the product catalog.\n\n - Monitor global privacy developments and translate implications into practical guidance for products, operations, market expansion, and customer commitments.\n\n\n\nPrivacy Program Operations & Governance\n\n - Mature Trulioo’s privacy program, including PIAs, DPIAs, records of processing, data subject rights, vendor privacy reviews, and cross-border transfer mechanisms. Integrate privacy by design into product development, commercial contracting, customer onboarding, third-party management, enterprise risk management, and agile operating rhythms.\n\n - Own and evolve key privacy and data governance policies, including data retention, data classification, information classification and protection, data handling, and responsible data use.\n\n - Lead privacy incident readiness and response, including investigation support, breach assessment, regulatory notification analysis, remediation, and post-incident improvement.\n\n - Develop practical reporting, metrics, and executive-level insights that create visibility into privacy risks, regulatory readiness, and program maturity.\n\n\n\nCommercial Enablement, Product, & Engineering Advisor\n\n - Partner with Product and Engineering to embed privacy by design into agile product development, architecture decisions, data flows, and release processes.\n\n - Provide guidance on privacy risks tied to identity verification, fraud prevention, biometrics, document verification, data enrichment, AI, machine learning, and emerging identity technologies.\n\n - Serve as a senior privacy advisor to Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Solutions, and Legal in support of enterprise due diligence, RFPs, audits, and strategic customer engagements.\n\n - Help shape responsible AI governance, including privacy impact analysis, consumer data use, automated processing, transparency, and controls for responsible product deployment.\n\n - Lead or support negotiation of DPAs, SCCs, data transfer terms, privacy schedules, customer commitments, vendor terms, and partner arrangements.\n\n - Support commercialization by validating privacy positioning, customer-facing claims, contractual commitments, and market- specific privacy requirements.\n\n - Build privacy thought leadership that strengthens Trulioo’s credibility with customers, regulators, partners, and industry stakeholders.\n\n\n\nTeam Leadership & Cross-Functional Influence\n\n - Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing privacy team with strong judgment, business orientation, and operational discipline.\n\n - Create clear decision-making frameworks that allow teams to move quickly while managing privacy and data protection risk effectively.\n\n - Foster a culture of responsible innovation, practical risk management, and accountable data use across the organization.\n\n\n\n\nWHAT YOU’LL BRING:\n\n - 15+ years of experience in privacy, data protection, technology law, regulatory advisory, or related legal and risk leadership roles, including significant in-house experience.\n\n - Extensive expertise in GDPR, European data protection expectations, U.S. state privacy laws, and Canadian privacy laws.\n\n - Demonstrated ability to serve as a senior privacy leader or Data Protection Officer in a complex, global technology environment.\n\n - Experience advising Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, and go-to-market teams on privacy by design, data protection risk, product launches, and customer-facing commitments.\n\n - Practical experience with PIAs, DPIAs, data mapping, transfer mechanisms, DPAs, SCCs, vendor risk, data subject rights, retention, and privacy incident response.\n\n - Strong understanding of privacy issues tied to emerging identity technology and use cases including biometrics, identity, AI, behavior analysis, automated processing, fraud prevention, and device intelligence.\n\n - Track record building or maturing privacy program operations in agile, high-growth, regulated, or enterprise SaaS environments.\n\n - Executive presence, sound judgment, and the ability to translate regulatory complexity into clear business decisions.\n\n - Strong people leadership skills, with the ability to build capability, set direction, and raise the operating maturity of a privacy function.\n\n - Law degree or equivalent legal/privacy qualification; membership in good standing with a relevant law society or bar is strongly preferred.\n\n\n\n\nNICE TO HAVE:\n\n - Experience in RegTech, FinTech, identity verification, fraud prevention, payments, financial services, or enterprise SaaS.\n\n - Working knowledge of privacy and data protection frameworks in Asia-Pacific, India, China, and Latin America.\n\n - Experience supporting AI governance, responsible AI programs, model governance, or data ethics frameworks.\n\n - Familiarity with information security, data governance, cybersecurity, enterprise risk, or public-company readiness programs.\n\n - Privacy certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPP/US, CIPP/C, CIPM, CIPT, or equivalent credentials.\n\n - Experience speaking externally, publishing privacy insights, or representing a company in industry forums.\n\n\n\n\nINTERVIEW PROCESS:\n\nAt Trulioo, we strive to create an interview experience that is transparent, engaging, and respectful of your time. Mature Trulioo’s privacy program, including PIAs, DPIAs, records of processing, data subject rights, vendor privacy reviews, and cross-border transfer mechanisms. Integrate privacy by design into product development, commercial contracting, customer onboarding, third-party management, enterprise risk management, and agile operating rhythms.\n\n - Own and evolve key privacy and data governance policies, including data retention, data classification, information classification and protection, data handling, and responsible data use.\n\n - Lead privacy incident readiness and response, including investigation support, breach assessment, regulatory notification analysis, remediation, and post-incident improvement.\n\n - Develop practical reporting, metrics, and executive-level insights that create visibility into privacy risks, regulatory readiness, and program maturity.\n\n\n\nCommercial Enablement, Product, & Engineering Advisor\n\n - Partner with Product and Engineering to embed privacy by design into agile product development, architecture decisions, data flows, and release processes.\n\n - Provide guidance on privacy risks tied to identity verification, fraud prevention, biometrics, document verification, data enrichment, AI, machine learning, and emerging identity technologies.\n\n - Serve as a senior privacy advisor to Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Solutions, and Legal in support of enterprise due diligence, RFPs, audits, and strategic customer engagements.\n\n - Help shape responsible AI governance, including privacy impact analysis, consumer data use, automated processing, transparency, and controls for responsible product deployment.\n\n - Lead or support negotiation of DPAs, SCCs, data transfer terms, privacy schedules, customer commitments, vendor terms, and partner arrangements.\n\n - Support commercialization by validating privacy positioning, customer-facing claims, contractual commitments, and market- specific privacy requirements.\n\n - Create clear decision-making frameworks that allow teams to move quickly while managing privacy and data protection risk effectively.\n\n - Foster a culture of responsible innovation, practical risk management, and accountable data use across the organization.\n\n\n\n\nWHAT YOU’LL BRING:\n\n - 15+ years of experience in privacy, data protection, technology law, regulatory advisory, or related legal and risk leadership roles, including significant in-house experience.\n\n - Extensive expertise in GDPR, European data protection expectations, U.S. state privacy laws, and Canadian privacy laws.\n\n - Demonstrated ability to serve as a senior privacy leader or Data Protection Officer in a complex, global technology environment.\n\n - Experience advising Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, and go-to-market teams on privacy by design, data protection risk, product launches, and customer-facing commitments.\n\n - Practical experience with PIAs, DPIAs, data mapping, transfer mechanisms, DPAs, SCCs, vendor risk, data subject rights, retention, and privacy incident response.\n\n - Strong understanding of privacy issues tied to emerging identity technology and use cases including biometrics, identity, AI, behavior analysis, automated processing, fraud prevention, and device intelligence.\n\n - Track record building or maturing privacy program operations in agile, high-growth, regulated, or enterprise SaaS environments.\n\n - Executive presence, sound judgment, and the ability to translate regulatory complexity into clear business decisions.\n\n - Strong people leadership skills, with the ability to build capability, set direction, and raise the operating maturity of a privacy function.\n\n - Law degree or equivalent legal/privacy qualification; membership in good standing with a relevant law society or bar is strongly preferred.\n\n\n\n\nNICE TO HAVE:\n\n - This is a senior leadership role for a privacy executive who can operate in scaling, agile environments and partnering with Product, Engineering, Legal, Security, Enterprise Risk, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.\n\n\n\nThe ideal candidate brings extensive expertise in GDPR, U.S. state privacy laws, and Canadian privacy laws, with experience in emerging areas including, but not limited to, biometrics, AI, age verification, data retention, data classification, and emerging identity technologies.\n\n\n\nThis role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.\n\n\n\nThis will be a full-time, permanent position working on a hybrid model from one of our North American offices or fully remote.\n\n\n\n\nWHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:\n\nGlobal Privacy Strategy & DPO\n\n - Build and lead Trulioo’s global privacy and data protection strategy across priority markets, products, customers, and operating environments.\n\n - Serve as Trulioo’s designated Data Protection Officer for Europe, providing independent, credible, and commercially practical advice on GDPR and related obligations.\n\n - Advise executive leadership, as needed, on privacy risk, regulatory change, customer expectations, and strategic trade-offs tied to product innovation and market expansion.\n\n - Represent Trulioo in privacy-related engagements with regulators, enterprise customers, industry groups, and other external stakeholders.\n\n - Act as a strategic advisor on privacy and data protection implications as Trulioo expands into new operating regions, verticals, and expands the product catalog.\n\n - Monitor global privacy developments and translate implications into practical guidance for products, operations, market expansion, and customer commitments.\n\n\n\nPrivacy Program Operations & Governance\n\n - Mature Trulioo’s privacy program, including PIAs, DPIAs, records of processing, data subject rights, vendor privacy reviews, and cross-border transfer mechanisms. Integrate privacy by design into product development, commercial contracting, customer onboarding, third-party management, enterprise risk management, and agile operating rhythms.\n\n - Own and evolve key privacy and data governance policies, including data retention, data classification, information classification and protection, data handling, and responsible data use.\n\n - Lead privacy incident readiness and response, including investigation support, breach assessment, regulatory notification analysis, remediation, and post-incident improvement.\n\n - Develop practical reporting, metrics, and executive-level insights that create visibility into privacy risks, regulatory readiness, and program maturity.\n\n\n\nCommercial Enablement, Product, & Engineering Advisor\n\n - Partner with Product and Engineering to embed privacy by design into agile product development, architecture decisions, data flows, and release processes.\n\n - Provide guidance on privacy risks tied to identity verification, fraud prevention, biometrics, document verification, data enrichment, AI, machine learning, and emerging identity technologies.\n\n - Serve as a senior privacy advisor to Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Solutions, and Legal in support of enterprise due diligence, RFPs, audits, and strategic customer engagements.\n\n - Help shape responsible AI governance, including privacy impact analysis, consumer data use, automated processing, transparency, and controls for responsible product deployment.\n\n - Lead or support negotiation of DPAs, SCCs, data transfer terms, privacy schedules, customer commitments, vendor terms, and partner arrangements.\n\n - Support commercialization by validating privacy positioning, customer-facing claims, contractual commitments, and market- specific privacy requirements.\n\n - Build privacy thought leadership that strengthens Trulioo’s credibility with customers, regulators, partners, and industry stakeholders.\n\n\n\nTeam Leadership & Cross-Functional Influence\n\n - Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing privacy team with strong judgment, business orientation, and operational discipline.\n\n - Create clear decision-making frameworks that allow teams to move quickly while managing privacy and data protection risk effectively.\n\n - Foster a culture of responsible innovation, practical risk management, and accountable data use across the organization.\n\n\n\n\nWHAT YOU’LL BRING:\n\n - 15+ years of experience in privacy, data protection, technology law, regulatory advisory, or related legal and risk leadership roles, including significant in-house experience.\n\n - Extensive expertise in GDPR, European data protection expectations, U.S. state privacy laws, and Canadian privacy laws.\n\n - Demonstrated ability to serve as a senior privacy leader or Data Protection Officer in a complex, global technology environment.\n\n - Experience advising Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, and go-to-market teams on privacy by design, data protection risk, product launches, and customer-facing commitments.\n\n - Practical experience with PIAs, DPIAs, data mapping, transfer mechanisms, DPAs, SCCs, vendor risk, data subject rights, retention, and privacy incident response.\n\n - Strong understanding of privacy issues tied to emerging identity technology and use cases including biometrics, identity, AI, behavior analysis, automated processing, fraud prevention, and device intelligence.\n\n - Track record building or maturing privacy program operations in agile, high-growth, regulated, or enterprise SaaS environments.\n\n - Executive presence, sound judgment, and the ability to translate regulatory complexity into clear business decisions.\n\n - Strong people leadership skills, with the ability to build capability, set direction, and raise the operating maturity of a privacy function.\n\n - Law degree or equivalent legal/privacy qualification; membership in good standing with a relevant law society or bar is strongly preferred.\n\n\n\n\nNICE TO HAVE:\n\n - Experience in RegTech, FinTech, identity verification, fraud prevention, payments, financial services, or enterprise SaaS.\n\n - Working knowledge of privacy and data protection frameworks in Asia-Pacific, India, China, and Latin America.\n\n - Experience supporting AI governance, responsible AI programs, model governance, or data ethics frameworks.\n\n - Familiarity with information security, data governance, cybersecurity, enterprise risk, or public-company readiness programs.\n\n - Privacy certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPP/US, CIPP/C, CIPM, CIPT, or equivalent credentials.\n\n - Experience speaking externally, publishing privacy insights, or representing a company in industry forums.\n\n\n\n\nINTERVIEW PROCESS:\n\nAt Trulioo, we strive to create an interview experience that is transparent, engaging, and respectful of your time. Build and lead Trulioo’s global privacy and data protection strategy across priority markets, products, customers, and operating environments.\n\n - Serve as Trulioo’s designated Data Protection Officer for Europe, providing independent, credible, and commercially practical advice on GDPR and related obligations.\n\n - Advise executive leadership, as needed, on privacy risk, regulatory change, customer expectations, and strategic trade-offs tied to product innovation and market expansion.\n\n - Represent Trulioo in privacy-related engagements with regulators, enterprise customers, industry groups, and other external stakeholders.\n\n - Act as a strategic advisor on privacy and data protection implications as Trulioo expands into new operating regions, verticals, and expands the product catalog.\n\n - Monitor global privacy developments and translate implications into practical guidance for products, operations, market expansion, and customer commitments.\n\n\n\nPrivacy Program Operations & Governance\n\n - Mature Trulioo’s privacy program, including PIAs, DPIAs, records of processing, data subject rights, vendor privacy reviews, and cross-border transfer mechanisms. Integrate privacy by design into product development, commercial contracting, customer onboarding, third-party management, enterprise risk management, and agile operating rhythms.\n\n - Own and evolve key privacy and data governance policies, including data retention, data classification, information classification and protection, data handling, and responsible data use.\n\n - Lead privacy incident readiness and response, including investigation support, breach assessment, regulatory notification analysis, remediation, and post-incident improvement.\n\n - Develop practical reporting, metrics, and executive-level insights that create visibility into privacy risks, regulatory readiness, and program maturity.\n\n\n\nCommercial Enablement, Product, & Engineering Advisor\n\n - Partner with Product and Engineering to embed privacy by design into agile product development, architecture decisions, data flows, and release processes.\n\n - Provide guidance on privacy risks tied to identity verification, fraud prevention, biometrics, document verification, data enrichment, AI, machine learning, and emerging identity technologies.\n\n - Serve as a senior privacy advisor to Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Solutions, and Legal in support of enterprise due diligence, RFPs, audits, and strategic customer engagements.\n\n - Help shape responsible AI governance, including privacy impact analysis, consumer data use, automated processing, transparency, and controls for responsible product deployment.\n\n - Lead or support negotiation of DPAs, SCCs, data transfer terms, privacy schedules, customer commitments, vendor terms, and partner arrangements.\n\n - Support commercialization by validating privacy positioning, customer-facing claims, contractual commitments, and market- specific privacy requirements.\n\n - Build privacy thought leadership that strengthens Trulioo’s credibility with customers, regulators, partners, and industry stakeholders.\n\n\n\nTeam Leadership & Cross-Functional Influence\n\n - Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing privacy team with strong judgment, business orientation, and operational discipline.\n\n - Create clear decision-making frameworks that allow teams to move quickly while managing privacy and data protection risk effectively.\n\n - Foster a culture of responsible innovation, practical risk management, and accountable data use across the organization.\n\n\n\n\nWHAT YOU’LL BRING:\n\n - 15+ years of experience in privacy, data protection, technology law, regulatory advisory, or related legal and risk leadership roles, including significant in-house experience.\n\n - Extensive expertise in GDPR, European data protection expectations, U.S. state privacy laws, and Canadian privacy laws.\n\n - Demonstrated ability to serve as a senior privacy leader or Data Protection Officer in a complex, global technology environment.\n\n - Experience advising Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, and go-to-market teams on privacy by design, data protection risk, product launches, and customer-facing commitments.\n\n - Practical experience with PIAs, DPIAs, data mapping, transfer mechanisms, DPAs, SCCs, vendor risk, data subject rights, retention, and privacy incident response.\n\n - Strong understanding of privacy issues tied to emerging identity technology and use cases including biometrics, identity, AI, behavior analysis, automated processing, fraud prevention, and device intelligence.\n\n - Track record building or maturing privacy program operations in agile, high-growth, regulated, or enterprise SaaS environments.\n\n - Executive presence, sound judgment, and the ability to translate regulatory complexity into clear business decisions.\n\n - Strong people leadership skills, with the ability to build capability, set direction, and raise the operating maturity of a privacy function.\n\n - Law degree or equivalent legal/privacy qualification; membership in good standing with a relevant law society or bar is strongly preferred.\n\n\n\n\nNICE TO HAVE:\n\n - Experience in RegTech, FinTech, identity verification, fraud prevention, payments, financial services, or enterprise SaaS.\n\n - Working knowledge of privacy and data protection frameworks in Asia-Pacific, India, China, and Latin America.\n\n - Experience supporting AI governance, responsible AI programs, model governance, or data ethics frameworks.\n\n - Familiarity with information security, data governance, cybersecurity, enterprise risk, or public-company readiness programs.\n\n - Privacy certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPP/US, CIPP/C, CIPM, CIPT, or equivalent credentials.\n\n - Experience speaking externally, publishing privacy insights, or representing a company in industry forums.\n\n\n\n\nINTERVIEW PROCESS:\n\nAt Trulioo, we strive to create an interview experience that is transparent, engaging, and respectful of your time. We are a united force of dedicated experts committed to establishing trust online - and we’re proud to be recognized as a <strong>BC Top Employer for the second consecutive year</strong>, reflecting our commitment to an inclusive, collaborative, and people-first workplace.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Headquartered in Vancouver and with strategic hubs in San Diego and Dublin, we foster a culture of collaboration and open communication. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p></li></ul><h2><strong>Position Summary:</strong></h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">For most of the last two decades, identity verification has meant one thing: check the box once, then move on. A business signs up, submits its documents, passes a screen, and is trusted from that day forward, until an audit eventually forces someone to look again. That model was built for a world where risk held still. It doesn't anymore. Shell companies change hands overnight. Fabricated documents pass automated review. A vendor that was clean in January can be laundering money by June.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Trulioo's bet is that trust isn't a moment. It's a lifecycle: screen, verify, assess, monitor, on repeat, for as long as the relationship lasts. The world of risk has quietly evolved… and so has Trulioo.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We're not hiring someone to keep a blog updated or manage a content calendar. We're hiring the person who builds the public case for why continuous intelligence beats a one-time stamp of approval, and who makes Trulioo the name people associate with that idea before a competitor claims it first.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">This will be a full-time, permanent position, preferably working out of one of our offices on a hybrid model (3-days per week in the office), but could be done remotely for the right candidate.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2><strong>What You’ll Be Doing:</strong></h2><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Build the story and own it everywhere it needs to live: PR, thought leadership, and an editorial cadence that actually ships, not one that lives in a content calendar nobody opens.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Take Trulioo's category language, verified identity versus verified risk, defensible decisioning, a system of trust, and turn it into something a CRO or CCO repeats back to us unprompted.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Own the website as a narrative surface, not a features list. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p></li></ul><h2><strong>Position Summary:</strong></h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">For most of the last two decades, identity verification has meant one thing: check the box once, then move on. A business signs up, submits its documents, passes a screen, and is trusted from that day forward, until an audit eventually forces someone to look again. That model was built for a world where risk held still. It doesn't anymore. Shell companies change hands overnight. Fabricated documents pass automated review. A vendor that was clean in January can be laundering money by June.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Trulioo's bet is that trust isn't a moment. It's a lifecycle: screen, verify, assess, monitor, on repeat, for as long as the relationship lasts. The world of risk has quietly evolved… and so has Trulioo.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We're not hiring someone to keep a blog updated or manage a content calendar. We're hiring the person who builds the public case for why continuous intelligence beats a one-time stamp of approval, and who makes Trulioo the name people associate with that idea before a competitor claims it first.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">This will be a full-time, permanent position, preferably working out of one of our offices on a hybrid model (3-days per week in the office), but could be done remotely for the right candidate.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2><strong>What You’ll Be Doing:</strong></h2><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Build the story and own it everywhere it needs to live: PR, thought leadership, and an editorial cadence that actually ships, not one that lives in a content calendar nobody opens.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Take Trulioo's category language, verified identity versus verified risk, defensible decisioning, a system of trust, and turn it into something a CRO or CCO repeats back to us unprompted.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Own the website as a narrative surface, not a features list. If someone reads the homepage and doesn't understand Trulioo’s value by the time they leave, it's not done yet.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Turn Trulioo's own data on fraud patterns, identity risk, and verification trends into original research and benchmark reports, the kind of proprietary insight that makes a journalist call us first, not a whitepaper that makes them delete an email.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Push the work past the page.
